answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Chartered local government auditor account with local auditors certification, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. The farm's edge dies on cost: each alias adds 113 POA of exposure, so 379 aliases carry 42827 POA of risk for one epoch's payout. The mesa test is the live device, the karst test is the locked stake, and the oasis test is the graded history no template can fake. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
